# Minecraft Version(s): 26.3
## The Wilderness Bound update had lots of small technical changes which added up - so please report any Bugs you catch on our Discord server. 
## We also moved away from crowdin for our translations and now have our own solution. Feel free to contribute: https://explorerseden.eu/translate/
## Thank you!

## Changes:
- Added 7 progression advancements

## Fixes:
- Removed some unused references for past Baby Name Tag functionalities
